note: M2, the anchored machine re-roll (art plan batch M), 2026-10-30. Overrides m1_machines.json by name. One create_1_direction_object job, 10 generations: no size (the 32x32 anchors set it, 64 candidates), view top-down, palette = the 46 Apollo hexes, palette_name Apollo, name m2_machines, style_images = art/ref/anchors_m2/style_images.json (b_miner, b_foundry, b_press, b_spore_filter, b_cutter, b_attuner, b_spore_collector, b_overcharger, rendered as art:build places them, with this batch's family-accent recolours). PixelLab review object ba5272eb-13f2-44a3-83c5-7c2a7fe95ced (job 4c8b4a2a-5c64-428a-bf4a-8308561029a6). All 64 frames are kept untouched in art/raw/m2/candidates/frame_<i>.png (slot map in _slots); every frame came back 100% Apollo with no partial alpha. The 11 picks were promoted with select_object_frames (tag m2_machines) and saved as art/raw/m2/<name>.png, byte-identical to their frames (_object = the promoted object). Free fixes are in art/edit/m2/edits.json (node scripts/art/recolor.ts art/edit/m2/edits.json rebuilds art/edit/m2/*.png; raw files stay untouched). M3 was not needed: after M2 and the free fixes every 2x2 machine and 32 px decor has art. _light / _work are [x, y, w, h] in final 32 x 32 sprite pixels (after trim and bottom-centre placement), for the anchor fields of art plan issue 11 (not read by art:build yet).
_prompt: description: factory machine sprite in high top-down 3/4 view, flat top and a thin south face, square base filling the frame, selective dark outline, lit from upper left, no ground shadow. Each item_description starts 'factory machine in high top-down 3/4 view, seen from above:' and describes the TOP surface, a base plate filling the whole frame edge to edge, and a plain south face; the full 64 lines are in _slots.

_family_audit: Style issue 7 (STYLE.md Machine families) checked on every M1 pick by colour count. Fixed for free in art/edit/m2/edits.json: Extraction stripes were #e8c170/#341c27 (the Heat mouth, selection and money colour) instead of #de9e41/#151d28; Heat brick was the earth browns #602c2c/#7a4841/#4d2b32 (the L1 floor and rock colours, no #752438 at all) instead of #752438/#a53030; Fabrication had no #be772b rivets anywhere, the press was #394a50 belt-grey steel like the Crystal family, and the assembler and precision assembler had #3c5e8b blue south faces (the precision assembler's with #a4dddb glass glints, the Chemistry accent). Replaced: b_crusher (2 cyan pixels, no Crystal accent) and b_cooling_bath (tan clay frame, no light spot, baked steam, a spout that read as a side chute). Kept as M1: b_cutter and b_overcharger (their coils lean #a4dddb over #73bed3; recolouring them to #73bed3/#4f8fba made them match the L3 rock lip and veins, so they would sink into their own layer: see the report), b_spore_filter, b_attuner and the decor.
_spend: 10 generations (one create_1_direction_object job, review object ba5272eb-13f2-44a3-83c5-7c2a7fe95ced); M3 not run, so 14 of the 24-generation allowance are unspent. Account generations_used: 3,771.1 when this agent started, 3,809.1 right before the call, 3,812.1 right after queueing, 3,852.1 at the end (other agents were generating in parallel). The $2.00 credit was not touched. select_object_frames, get_object and pixelart_workbench calls were free.
